scenarios.prompt: Enter a vehicle, transfer control/input/camera ownership once, then exit to a project-valid safe locomotion surface.

criteria.ownership: Exactly one rider or vehicle control owner exists through enter and exit.
criteria.session: Vehicle and mount-session IDs make duplicate requests idempotent.
criteria.evidence: Safe-exit policy and failure reason are explicit and not universally tied to one navigation representation.
